base_member_text: [L5,L10] (HIGH/shape-conformance) The dummy array extent is MAXDIMS but it is assigned a fixed six-element constructor, which is nonconforming unless MAXDIMS is exactly 6.
audit_member_text: [L5,L10] (LOW/hard-coded dimension contract) The output extent is declared with `MAXDIMS` but initialized with a fixed six-element constructor, so the template silently assumes `MAXDIMS == 6` and becomes nonconforming if that parameter changes.

base_member_text: [L10,L12-L29] (MED/ambiguous-api-result) An unknown variable leaves the all-zero result unchanged, which is indistinguishable from the scalar convention that explicitly reports shape(1)=0.
audit_member_text: [L10,L12-L29] (LOW/ambiguous API failure result) There is no default case or status result for an unknown name, which therefore returns the same all-zero shape representation used for a scalar and gives the C caller no way to distinguish lookup failure.

base_member_text: [L14-L28] (MED/rank-bound-contract) Generated indices are based solely on each metadata rank with no assertion that rank is at most MAXDIMS, so higher-rank metadata would write beyond shape.
[L4,L7,L9] (MED/unterminated-c-string-contract) The assumed-size C name is passed to strlen without an explicit bound, relying on an undocumented caller-supplied NUL terminator.

[L21-L25] (LOW/metadata-drift) When metadata supplies a shape, the template returns those constants instead of querying the live variable, with no check that the declared metadata still matches the object.
